name: GET /api/leadflow/saved-views/counts - live, and null when uncomputable
description:
Recomputes the pinned views' counts on every read.

NULL, NEVER ZERO, for a count that could not be computed. Zero is a real answer that says "nothing matches, move on"; a failed count rendering as zero tells somebody their queue is empty when it is not, and they go and do something else. QA: measured live returning a real count against the view created earlier.

testCases.name: Counts are recomputed per pinned view, with null for any that failed
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
